status_detail: Childersburg City Council approved Ordinance #1156 to add data centers as a permitted PUD use and approved Resolution 2026-02 for right-of-entry/predevelopment site work; mayor told Inside Climate News the early-stage proposal was a $6B, 500 MW data center on 486 acres, with sale/site assessment still pending.
notes: Developer name is not fully confirmed in city/public-hearing reporting; sources identify WHP/Western Hospitality as likely tied to Josh Harrelson/WHP Development. Project remains early-stage and not finalized.

project_name: Historic Tallassee Mill data center proposal
status_detail: City minutes record mayor saying nothing had been decided and experts would be brought in; WSFA later reported Mayor Joey Wiginton said the possibility of a data center along the Tallapoosa River was off the table for now and not expected in Tallassee anytime soon.
notes: Tallassee spans Elmore/Tallapoosa area and reporting locates the possible site at the historic mill along the Tallapoosa River; included for Tallapoosa County coverage because county GIS/official city site references Tallapoosa County jurisdiction and local comments identify the mill side as Tallapoosa County.

status_detail: ADEM construction stormwater permit ALR10C8B4 was issued to APLD BHM-01 LLC effective July 20, 2026 for a roughly 2,000,000 sq ft industrial building with 136.89 acres of disturbance on Applied Digital-controlled land; reporting says construction was anticipated from late July 2026 to end-2028, while Applied Digital said no final proceed decision had been made.
notes: Permit documents reportedly use generic industrial naming, with data-center wording in appendices. ABC 33/40 notes timing resembles Applied Digital's undisclosed Delta Forge 2, which the company described as 210 MW critical IT load, but sources do not explicitly identify Brookwood as Delta Forge 2, so capacity_mw left null.
